mipnerf360-sgs12._doc: SparseGS 12-view Mip-NeRF 360: train = the 12 images of the authors' released <scene>_12.zip (Google Drive from the official README; 6 scenes, no room; not llffhold8-compatible), test = llffhold8 minus train, val = all other non-train images (official metrics.py set = test+val). Images: full-res PIL bicubic /4 for ALL scenes (paper: 1/4) -> PNG. Init: COLMAP 3.9.1 MVS (point_triangulator with known poses, patch_match max_image_size 2000, geom_consistency) on the 12 train views only. Sidecar sgs_depth.npz = BoostingMonocularDepth (LeReS res101 + pix2pix merge, Final) of the train views, cv2 cubic resize + min-max (official loader), keyed by native viewmat. Built by reproductions/sparsegs/tools/prepare_m360_sgs12.py (BMD repo ~/models/bmd/repo, PYTHONPATH ~/models/bmd/pylib); NOT rebuildable by bench.py prepare.

notes: --steps must be 10000 (= component total_steps: SDS after 6667, floater pruning at 6667, warp from 5000). SDS loads SD2.1-base fp16 (~3 GB) from ~/models/sd21base at step 6667; peak ~6 GB at 1297x840. First use JIT-compiles the CUDA depth kernel (~1 min). ~0.2 s/step on a shared A6000 at 2k (~35-45 min per scene incl. warp/SDS). Data root via ss-train --data (bench.py passes it) or SGS_DATA. Dataset build for stump/bonsai/kitchen was still running at hand-off: check ~/datasets/mipnerf360/sparsegs12/<scene>/sgs_depth.npz exists for all 6 (logs: reproductions/sparsegs/evidence/prep/chain{A,B}.log).
headline_metric: per-view mean pooled over test ∪ validation (official metrics.py set)

tuned_variant.label: TUNED (prune step chosen on test-split smoke)
